stages: A (home screen only, no task) then B (mission + 9 screens with shuffled labels K–Z, no step numbers)
hint_check: Missions avoid the words block, reissue, virtual, temporary, permanent. The dialog screen itself shows 'Block temporarily / Block permanently': the tested labels could not be neutralized, so unanimity at s3 is weighted lower.

cast.name: Dan, 29
cast.arrival: installed the app for the first time today
cast.knows_cold: how card payments work in shops
cast.objections: does not know where things live in the app
cast.would_convert_if: finds what he needs without guessing
cast.gives_up_when: has to guess what a button does with his money
cast.mission: Deal with the lost card in the app and be able to buy lunch today
quotes: Lost it, not stolen. So which block do I pick?
Five to seven days. So what do I pay for lunch today?

cast.name: Valentina, 66
cast.arrival: grandson set up the app; she only checks the balance
cast.knows_cold: her pension arrives on the card
cast.objections: afraid of irreversible taps; distrusts technical words
cast.would_convert_if: every button says plainly what happens
cast.gives_up_when: a choice looks irreversible; then she phones the bank
cast.mission: Make sure nobody takes my pension with that card and get a card back
quotes: Which one is the permanent one? I don't want to lose my money.
What does reissue mean? Is that a new card?

cast.name: Marina, 41
cast.arrival: father's wallet was stolen; she came over
cast.objections: not sure she may act in his account; father moved recently
cast.would_convert_if: card stopped now, new one reaches the current address
cast.gives_up_when: the app needs something only her father can do
cast.mission: Stop Dad's card and get him a new one at his new place
quotes: Is it even mine to do this? It's his account.
Please just show me the address before I press the button.

summary.main_friction: No way to pay today; fee amount not stated
Chose temporary block: 'permanent' reads as irreversible
Cannot check the delivery address before confirming
